editorial_contributions.text:
In the present bibliography the author lists 14 items among which are six of this same volume, in approximately chronological order, of all literature that is directly related to the number field sieve.


1. \textit{J. M. Pollard}, Factoring with cubic integers (2), unpublished manuscript, 3 pages, December 1988. (This forms a footnote to the previous paper (this vol., pp. 4-10). It reports on the factorization of \(2^{144}-3\).)


2. \textit{D. M. Gordon}, Discrete logarithms in \(GF(p)\) using the number field sieve, SIAM J. Discrete Math. 6, 124-138 (1993; Zbl 0772.11046), prepublication: 15 pages, April 27, 1990.


3. \textit{L. M. Adleman}, Factoring numbers using singular integers, Proc. 23rd Annual ACM Symp. on Theory of Computing (STOC), New Orleans, May 6- 8, 1991, 64-71; prepublication: TR-20, Department of Computer Science, University of Southern California, 8 pages, September 4, 1990.


4. \textit{D. Coppersmith}, Modifications to the number field sieve, J. Cryptology 6, 169-180 (1993; see the review 11071 below), prepublication: IBM Research Report \#RC 16264, Yorktown Heights, New York, 16 pages, November 1990.


5. \textit{A. K. Lenstra}, \textit{H. W. Lenstra, jun.}, \textit{M. S. Manasse}, \textit{J. M. Pollard}, The factorization of the ninth Fermat number, Math. Comput. 61, 319-349 (1993; Zbl 0792.11055).


6. \textit{O. Schirokauer}, On pro-finite groups and on discrete logarithms, Ph. D. thesis, University of California, Berkeley, 68 pages, May 1992.


7. \textit{D. M. Gordon}, Designing and detecting trapdoors for discrete log cryptosystems, Advances in cryptology, Crypto '92, to appear.


8. \textit{J. Buchmann}, \textit{J. Loho}, \textit{J. Zayer}, An implementation of the general number field sieve, extended abstract, Fachbereich Informatik, Universität des Saarlandes, 7 pages, May 1993.

For the entire collection see [Zbl 0777.00017].
